title: Two routes to one final heading
description: Which sequence matches both the panel after step 1 and the final panel?
question: Use the 4 x 3 grid with x increasing right and y up. Read each command relative to the current heading. Move the stated distance and face the direction traveled. Stay inside the grid. Which sequence matches both the panel after step 1 and the final panel?

answer.explanation: red (1, 2) to (1, 1) facing S. Then red (1, 1) to (2, 1) facing E. Then red (2, 1) to (2, 2) facing N. Then red (2, 2) to (2, 1) facing S. Every displayed constraint matches.
